notes: Company: Fluxory Cloudworks - mid-market SaaS (HelpFlow conversational desk product)
Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat agent (embedded in web app, mobile), tool-calling to CRM and search, 99.9% uptime across NA/EU
POC objective: validate hosted API latency SLOs, streaming UX (first byte + token pacing), tool calling reliability and webhook timeouts
CTO quote: '95th p95 < 200ms end-to-end for token stream to UI; if hosted can't hit that consistently we need Dedicated options'
SE notes: testing in na-east shows median streaming latency 120ms but p95 varies 180-320ms under load; need regional routing + fallback to cheaper model for degraded nodes
Security: legal wants SOC2 Type II evidence for Dedicated offer; SSO (SAML) mandatory; KMS integration for customer-managed keys is preferred
Cost sensitivity: product team expects high token churn; open to Dedicated if committed discount offsets management effort; concerned about burst cost spikes
Architecture preference: start hosted API for speed, then move to Dedicated reserve for consistent throughput after 90-day POC if economics work
Routing needs: smart-routing by region + model-fallback policy (e.g., route to eu-west then fallback to na or to 8-bit quantized variant), sticky session support for tool-calling state
Evaluation plan: 2-week functional POC + 4-week extended stress test; required artifacts: latency profiles by region, streaming inter-token gaps, webhook/tool-calling retry behavior
'Fallback policy' ask: automatic degrade to compatible model with controlled quality falloff and telemetry flags to alert DevOps
Notes from demo: function/tool call demo worked but observed 503s when concurrent tool calls > 30; SE proposed circuit-breaker + queued worker pattern
workload_summary: Mid-market SaaS (HelpFlow) evaluating Hosted API for chat/agent workload. Key constraints: streaming-first UX, tool-calling reliability (CRM/search webhooks), p95 latency target ~<200ms, regional NA/EU parity, failover to cheaper/quantized models under capacity pressure. POC roadmap: 2-week hosted streaming demo (regionally instrumented) -> extended throughput test -> pricing + Dedicated proposal if hosted doesn't meet p95 or cost targets.
